summary.text: Dexter Miller is the Democratic candidate for the Arkansas House of Representatives, District 62, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Mark McElroy; he ran against McElroy in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Dexter Miller was born in Lakeview, Arkansas, according to Ballotpedia.
He lost the 2022 general election for Arkansas House District 62 to incumbent Mark McElroy, 48.7 percent to 51.3 percent.
He ran against McElroy again in 2024 and received 46.3 percent of the vote to McElroy's 53.7 percent.
